text:
maria: Heads-up — quick preflight for tomorrow's deploy at 09:00 PT. Want to run a short runbook rehearsal (roleplay) at 08:30. Goal: confirm smoke checks, rollback steps, and who actually hits the toggle.
jordan: +1. I can be on-call for the canary monitor and handle the traffic switch if needed.
kai: I can shadow for DB migration rollback steps. Do we have the exact `rollback` CLI command baked into the runbook? :thinking_face:
maria: Yes — adding it to the runbook now. Primary rollback path is feature-flag off + service rollback. Secondary is DB snapshot restore for the migration. Sample snippet:

```
# rollback canary
redwood deploy rollback --env=staging --selector=canary-2026-09
# feature flag
ffctl set my-feature false --env=prod
```
sasha: Quick check — who is pressing the feature flag toggle in prod? We should pair that action with a second person to confirm metrics.
jordan: I'll press the toggle, lee will confirm metrics (latency, error-rate, 5xx). lee? :eyes:
lee: Yep I can watch the dashboards and confirm. I'll have the APM + custom SLO panel open and post a summary every 30s after toggle.
maria: Perfect. Runbook rehearsal agenda:
1) Trigger a simulated rollback in staging (kai)
2) Toggle feature in prod (jordan) while lee reads metrics
3) Re-deploy previous stable on canary if toggle doesn't fix (maria)
4) DB restore drill only if migration fails end-to-end (sasha)
Please confirm you can make 08:30 or if we should shift to 08:00.
jordan: 08:30 works.
kai: 08:30 for me.
sasha: 08:30. I'll bring the migration rollback checklist.
deploy-bot: Reminder — scheduled rehearsal meeting created for 08:30 PT with attendees @maria @jordan @kai @sasha @lee. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/rehearsal-341000
maria: Two extra clarifications:
- Rollback decision criteria: sustained >2x baseline error-rate for 3mins OR latency p50>500ms with p95 degradation >50%.
- If any uncertainty, default to rollback and open incident channel `#incidents`.
lee: Noted. I'll post a short template after rehearsal for what to include in the rollback summary (time, trigger, metric snapshots, who executed).
jordan: Last ask — does the runbook include the emergency kill-switch map (services and owners)? If not I'll paste it after rehearsal.
maria: It does, but please paste your condensed map anyway (helps for on-call). After rehearsal I'll update the runbook doc and tag everyone for final ack.
sasha: One more: can we rehearse the partial rollback path (canary only) and the full rollout rollback? Want to make sure traffic split restores cleanly.
maria: Yes — we'll simulate both. Plan: canary-only rollback first, then full rollout rollback if needed. That order keeps blast radius small.
lee: I'll prepare the smoke checklist items (health endpoints, sample queries, latencies, error logs grep commands) and push to the runbook before 08:00.
maria: Great — thanks team. If anyone can't make it DM me. Otherwise see you 08:30 PT. :rocket:
